## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

# **Exercise 1**


```{r}
# 步骤1: 安装并加载必要的包
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)  

# 步骤2: 读取CSV数据
data <- read_csv("pisa_2022.csv")

# 步骤3: 按国家分组，计算平均数学和阅读成绩
avg_scores <- data %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_math = mean(math, na.rm = TRUE),  # na.rm = TRUE 处理可能的缺失值
    avg_read = mean(read, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 步骤4: 绘制散点图（所有点黑色；标签用geom_label_repel带方框）
ggplot(avg_scores, aes(x = avg_math, y = avg_read)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +  # 统一所有点为黑色
  geom_label_repel(  # 替换为geom_label_repel，实现完整方框标签
    aes(label = country),
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    label.r = 0.15,
    label.size = 0.25,
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.5,   
    point.padding = 0.3, 
    max.overlaps = 12,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average reading against average maths for each country ",
    subtitle = "Any guesses on where Australia ranks?", 
    x = "mean scores in mathematics",
    y = "mean scores in reading"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()  # 使用简洁主题



```

```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(cowplot)  # 用于合并图表、提取图例

# 读取CSV数据
data <- read.csv("pisa_2022.csv")

# 计算每个国家、性别下的平均成绩
mean_scores <- data %>%
  group_by(country, gender) %>%
  summarise(
    math_mean = mean(math),
    read_mean = mean(read),
    science_mean = mean(science),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# 步骤3: 计算diff = female_mean - male_mean
wide_data <- mean_scores %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = gender, values_from = c(math_mean, read_mean, science_mean))

# 检查列名（调试用，可删）
# print("宽格式数据列名：")
# print(colnames(wide_data))

diff_data <- wide_data %>%
  mutate(
    math_diff = math_mean_female - math_mean_male,
    read_diff = read_mean_female - read_mean_male,
    science_diff = science_mean_female - science_mean_male
  ) %>%
  select(country, math_diff, read_diff, science_diff) %>%
  # 将country转为factor，按字母排序
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = unique(country[order(country)])))

# 输出diff值（可选，用于检查）
# print("每个国家各学科的性别差异 (female - male):")
# print(diff_data)

# 步骤4: 为每个学科绘制散点图（固定x轴范围 + x轴下方Boys/Girls标签 + 0参考线）
# 数学散点图（左侧，显示Y轴）
p_math <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = math_diff, y = country, color = math_diff > 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +  # 0参考线
  annotate("text", x = -30, y = -Inf, label = "boys", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +  # boys标签（左侧，下方）
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = -Inf, label = "girls", 
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +  # girls标签（右侧，下方）
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1AC9C9", "FALSE" = "red")) +  # 添加labels
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-60, 60)) +  # 固定x轴范围 (-60, 60)
  labs(title = "mean_math", 
       x = "diff", y = "country",
       color = "diff > 0") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),  # Y轴字体
        legend.position = "none") +  # 隐藏本图图例（稍后统一提取）
  NULL

# 阅读散点图（中间，隐藏Y轴）
p_read <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = read_diff, y = country, color = read_diff > 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = -30, y = -Inf, label = "boys", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = -Inf, label = "girls", 
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1AC9C9", "FALSE" = "red")
                     ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-60, 60)) +  # 固定x轴范围 (-60, 60)
  labs(title = "mean_read", 
       x = "diff", y = NULL,  # 隐藏Y标题
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # 隐藏Y刻度
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  NULL

# 科学散点图（右侧，隐藏Y轴）
p_science <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = science_diff, y = country, color = science_diff > 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = -30, y = -Inf, label = "boys", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = -Inf, label = "girls", 
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1AC9C9", "FALSE" = "red")
                     ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-60, 60)) +  # 固定x轴范围 (-60, 60)
  labs(title = "mean_sci", 
       x = "diff", y = NULL,
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  NULL

# 步骤5: 提取统一图例（从p_math）
legend <- get_legend(p_math + theme(legend.position = "right"))  # 提取并移到右侧

# 移除p_math的图例（重新定义无图例版）
p_math_no_legend <- p_math + theme(legend.position = "none")

# 合并三个图表（横向，共用Y轴，去掉A/B/C）
combined_plots <- plot_grid(p_math_no_legend, p_read, p_science, 
                            ncol = 3, nrow = 1, align = "h",
                            rel_widths = c(1, 1, 1))  # 等宽，去掉labels

# 将图例添加到右侧
combined_plot_base <- plot_grid(combined_plots, legend, 
                                ncol = 2, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(3, 0.5))  # 图:图例 = 3:0.5

# 添加整体标题和副标题（上移位置，为标题留更多空间）
combined_plot <- ggdraw() +  # 新建画布
  draw_label("Average gender difference (diff= female- male) per Country ", 
             fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, y = 0.95, size = 12) +  # 主标题，上移
  draw_label("Gender gap in reading is universal, but math and science gaps are not.",
             fontface = 'italic', x = 0.5, y = 0.90, size = 10) +  # 副标题
  draw_plot(combined_plot_base, x = 0, y = 0.05, width = 1, height = 0.85) 

# Display the merged graph
print(combined_plot)

```

# **Exercise 2**

```{r}

# 加载必要的包
library(ggplot2)

# 读取CSV文件，跳过前10行元数据
data <- read.csv("aus_median_house_price.csv", skip = 10, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# 第一列是时间（日期），转换为标准日期格式（假设季度末，如Mar-2002转换为2002-03-31）
data$Date <- as.Date(paste0(data[,1], "-01"), format = "%b-%Y-%d")
# 更精确的季度转换：将Mar-2002映射为2002-03-31，Jun-2002为2002-06-30等
months <- c("Mar" = "03-31", "Jun" = "06-30", "Sep" = "09-30", "Dec" = "12-31")
data$Date <- as.Date(paste0(substring(data[,1], 5, 8), "-", months[substring(data[,1], 1, 3)], 
                            substring(data[,1], 1, 3)), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# 提取Melbourne房屋中位数价格（第4列）
melbourne_prices <- data[, 4]  # 假设第4列是Melbourne价格，根据CSV结构确认
melbourne_df <- data.frame(Date = data$Date, Price = as.numeric(melbourne_prices))

# Remove NA values if there is empty data
melbourne_df <- na.omit(melbourne_df)

# Draw a line chart
ggplot(melbourne_df, aes(x = Date, y = Price)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +

  labs(title = "墨尔本既有房屋交易中位数价格趋势",
       x = "时间 (季度)",
       y = "Median price ($'000)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # 旋转x轴标签以避免重叠




```

```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# 读取房屋CSV文件，跳过前10行元数据
house_data <- read.csv("aus_median_house_price.csv", skip = 10, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 解析房屋日期（"Mar-2002" → 2002-03-31）
months <- c("Mar" = "03-31", "Jun" = "06-30", "Sep" = "09-30", "Dec" = "12-31")
house_data$Date <- as.Date(paste0(substring(house_data[,1], 5, 8), "-", months[substring(house_data[,1], 1, 3)]))

# 提取Melbourne房屋中位数价格（第4列）
melbourne_df <- data.frame(Date = house_data$Date, Price = as.numeric(house_data[, 4]))
melbourne_df <- na.omit(melbourne_df)  # 移除NA

# Read GDP CSV
gdp_data <- read.csv("aus_GDP_changes.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 解析GDP日期（"1/1/2002" → 2002-03-31；parts[1]是固定"1"，parts[2]是季度码"1/4/7/10"）
gdp_data$Date <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(gdp_data)) {
  date_str <- gdp_data$DATE[i]
  parts <- strsplit(date_str, "/")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) == 3) {
    qmonth <- parts[2]
    year <- parts[3]
    month_end <- switch(qmonth, "1" = "03-31", "4" = "06-30", "7" = "09-30", "10" = "12-31")
    if (!is.null(month_end)) {
      gdp_data$Date[i] <- as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month_end))
    }
  }
}
gdp_data$Date <- as.Date(gdp_data$Date)
gdp_data <- gdp_data[!is.na(gdp_data$Date), ]  # Remove invalid dates
gdp_data$GDP_changes <- as.numeric(gdp_data$GDP_changes)  # 转换为数值
gdp_data <- na.omit(gdp_data)  # Remove NA

# Filter housing time range (2002-03-31 to 2025-06-30)
start_date <- as.Date("2002-03-31")
end_date <- as.Date("2025-06-30")
gdp_filtered <- gdp_data[gdp_data$Date >= start_date & gdp_data$Date <= end_date, ]

# Identifying low growth periods（<0.1%）
low_gdp <- gdp_filtered[gdp_filtered$GDP_changes < 0.1, ]

# 为房屋数据添加新变量：low_gdp (TRUE if low growth in that quarter)
melbourne_df$low_gdp <- melbourne_df$Date %in% low_gdp$Date

# 创建阴影矩形数据框（每个低增长季度：xmin=季度开始, xmax=季度结束）
shadow_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = floor_date(low_gdp$Date, "quarter"),
  xmax = ceiling_date(low_gdp$Date, "quarter") - days(1),  # 季度结束前一天
  ymin = min(melbourne_df$Price) - 50,  # 价格范围缓冲
  ymax = max(melbourne_df$Price) + 50
)

# Draw a line chart + shadow
p <- ggplot(melbourne_df, aes(x = Date, y = Price)) +
  geom_rect(data = shadow_df, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = "grey", alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # 阴影区域
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +

  labs(title = "墨尔本既有房屋交易中位数价格趋势（阴影：GDP低增长期 <0.1%）",
       x = "时间 (季度)",
       y = "中位数价格 ($'000)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the chart
print(p)



```

# **Exercise 3**

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
library(here)
library(dplyr) 
library(dbplyr)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

actors <- read_csv(here("Actors.csv"))
castings <- read_csv(here("Castings.csv"))
directors <- read_csv(here("Directors.csv"))
movies <- read_csv(here( "Movies.csv"))
movies_and_directors <- read_csv(here("MoviesAndDirectors.csv"))

dbWriteTable(con, "actors", actors)
dbWriteTable(con, "castings", castings)
dbWriteTable(con, "directors", directors)
dbWriteTable(con, "movies", movies)
dbWriteTable(con, "movies_and_directors", movies_and_directors)

actors_db <- tbl(con, "actors")
castings_db <- tbl(con, "castings")
directors_db <- tbl(con, "directors")
movies_db <- tbl(con, "movies")
movies_directors_db <- tbl(con, "movies_and_directors")

# 使用现有的 tbl 对象
partnerships <- movies_db %>%
  inner_join(directors_db %>% rename(director_name = Name), by = "DirectorID") %>%
  inner_join(castings_db, by = "MovieID") %>%
  inner_join(actors_db %>% rename(actor_name = Name), by = "ActorID") %>%
  group_by(director_name, actor_name) %>%
  summarise(collaborations = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(collaborations))

# View the first few lines of the results
head(partnerships, 10)




```

```{r}

# Display the generated SQL query
show_query(partnerships)
```

```{r}
# dbplyr 等价查询
actor_stats <- actors_db %>%
  rename(Name.x = Name) %>%  # 别名为 Name.x (演员名)
  left_join(castings_db, by = "ActorID") %>%
  left_join(movies_db, by = "MovieID") %>%
  left_join(directors_db %>% rename(Name.y = Name), by = "DirectorID") %>%  # 别名为 Name.y (导演名)
  group_by(Name.x) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_directors = n_distinct(Name.y, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_movies = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(unique_directors))

# 执行并收集结果（collect() 将 lazy query 转为数据框）
result <- collect(actor_stats)

# Display the results
print(result)

# Display the generated SQL query
show_query(actor_stats)
```
